name: swe-lego-rl
description: Local marketplace for SWE-Lego-RL's preflight / launch / monitor skills.

plugins.name: rl
plugins.description: SWE-Lego-RL skills — preflight a config (dryrun + local live probe), launch a train/eval/infer run with an explicit parameter review, diagnose a run in flight, serve the training dashboard on whatever machine you are on, and install a sandbox Kubernetes cluster. Provides /rl:check, /rl:run, /rl:status, /rl:dashboard, /rl:k8s-sandbox-install.
